recognize_zh: 周邊血中出現一團細胞，細胞質藍、核偏心並可見核旁淡染區，但核形不規則、有凹陷或分葉，且大小不一；外周另有散在漿細胞，這是循環中的多形性漿細胞，符合漿細胞白血病。
features: Clump of seven atypical plasma cells plus scattered single plasma cells in peripheral blood
Variation in cell size with irregular, indented to lobated nuclei
Coarsely clumped chromatin; occasional indistinct nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm with eccentric nuclei and paranuclear hof
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cohesive-appearing clump of atypical plasma cells with additional single plasma cells in the surrounding field. The cells vary in size and show irregular, indented to lobated nuclei with coarse chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm with paranuclear clearing. The red cells are unremarkable in this field. Findings are consistent with circulating pleomorphic plasma cells, supporting plasma cell leukemia with anaplastic features in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Reactive circulating plasma cells are few, mature, uniform with round nuclei, and polytypic, unlike these pleomorphic lobated cells.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with IgM paraprotein rather than large pleomorphic plasma cells with lobated nuclei.
Monocytic cells have fine chromatin, folded nuclei, and gray cytoplasm with fine granules, and lack the perinuclear hof of plasma cells.
